_why: Git file review (GitReviewView.tsx, opened from Session Files → a changed file's own Review Changes button) had ZERO screenshots anywhere — the whole design-language effort never once looked at it (completeness-screens.md, 2026-09-23 audit). Root cause: the workbench mock-shim had no `git` namespace at all, so `window.claude.git.fileStatus()` silently fell through the outer bridge's catch-all and resolved `[]`; the footer read that as 'not a repo' and never rendered its 'Review Changes' door. Added a small generic `git` fixture to mock-shim.ts (2026-09-24, capture repair) — every open file now reads as 'one uncommitted edit, two commits of history', which is enough to picture the real component; it is not per-file accurate.
